lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-intensity, circular pixel clusters is visible across the mid-lateral flank, arranged in identifiable vertical columns and horizontal rows posterior to the pectoral fin attachment point.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical and horizontal bands of elevated luminance are visible intersecting at the centroids of the primary circular blobs, defining a checkerboard-like geometric framework on the mid-body.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank; they are characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high-luminance pixels on the dorsal side and shadow-biased low-luminance pixels on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal organisms (remoras) attached and swimming adjacent to the ventral surface and the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
